opening_annotation.strategic_intent: Early zergling pressure with speed upgrade and quick expansion
supporting_facts: The opening has a high rate of first combat unit observed (94.99%) compared to baseline (74.23%), indicating early zergling production.
The opening has a very high rate of first upgrade observed (98.75%) compared to baseline (14.53%), indicating early zergling movement speed upgrade.
The profile shows high investment in economy (0.467) and expansion (0.289), suggesting a fast expansion strategy.
The key sequence of the medoid includes Gas, Spawning Pool, Base, Queen, Upgrade (zergling movement speed), and Combat (ling/bane), confirming the build order.
